items.t: Downtown Vancouver Condos for Sale real estate

faq.q: Is Arbutus Ridge an official City of Vancouver area?
faq.a: Yes — Arbutus Ridge is one of the City's 22 distinct local areas, in the middle of the west side; the site slug "arbutus" is the short form of the same name.

faq.q: Which schools are located in Arbutus Ridge?
faq.a: Carnarvon Elementary, 3400 Balaclava Street, and Trafalgar Elementary, 4170 Trafalgar Street; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the VSB locator.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station or community centre in Arbutus Ridge?
faq.a: No to both in the sources read — the area is bus-served (the #14 runs Arbutus / West Boulevard, with the #25, #41, #49 and #99 nearby), and the City lists the Dunbar, Kitsilano and Kerrisdale community centres as its local services.

faq.q: Can an Arbutus Ridge house lot hold more than one home?
faq.a: Yes, where the R1-1 schedule is met — a single detached house may include a secondary suite and a laneway house, and a multiplex may have up to 6 units or up to 8 rental units, with minimum site areas from 306 m² to 557 m² by form.

faq.q: What is the Arbutus Greenway's role in the area?
faq.a: The City's walking and cycling corridor on the former Arbutus rail line — its temporary path runs 8.5 km along the east side of Arbutus Street and West Boulevard between Fir Street and Milton Street, along the area's east side.
